mapper.select: select s.song_id, s.title, s.artist, s.album_img, s.api_song_id, s.preview from favorites f join songs s on (f.song_id = s.song_id) where f.user_id = #{userId}
select song_id, title, artist, album_img, api_song_id, preview from songs WHERE api_song_id=#{apiSongId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO songs (title, artist, album_img, api_song_id, preview) VALUES (#{title}, #{artist}, #{albumImg}, #{apiSongId}, #{preview})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM favorites WHERE user_id=#{userId} and song_id=#{songId}
